text: Premium Subscription customers can request a refund within 30 days of purchase. Approved refunds are processed within 7 business days.

Premium Subscription customers can request a refund within 14 days of purchase. Refund requests submitted after 14 days are not automatically eligible for a refund. Approved refunds are processed within 5 business days.
Premium subscriptions must be cancelled at least 48 hours before the next billing date to avoid renewal.
Premium subscriptions can be cancelled at any time. Cancellation prevents the next billing cycle, but access continues until the current billing period ends.

Customers who notice duplicate charges should report the transaction to customer support. Duplicate charge cases require transaction verification before a refund can be approved. Verified duplicate charges are eligible for a full refund.

Accounts may be temporarily locked after multiple unsuccessful login attempts. Customers should use the password reset process to recover access. Cases involving suspected unauthorized access must be reviewed by a human support agent.
